verdict.rationale: Requiring SAML single sign-on is a fair security axis for a developer platform like GitHub, but the evidence pack never mentions SAML, SSO enforcement, or organization identity-provider configuration. The only authentication evidence covers social login with Google or Apple at account creation, SSH keys, and fine-grained personal access tokens, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can require SAML single sign-on for my organization
